text:
sophia: Quick sync request — want to align on HW lab windows + marketplace listing windows for H200, MI300, and Gaudi. Proposed agenda: compatibility tests, perf gates, driver/firmware slots, and joint announcement timing. :calendar:

igor: +1. we need kernel/driver matrix before we lock dates. AMD rep asked for our kernel baseline (5.15 vs 6.1) and ROCm version.

kevin: For MI300 smoke tests we run: `./ci/run_smoke.sh --model=llama2 --seq=1024 --batch=1` — need CUDA-equivalent harness for H200/H100 too. Also confirm MIG-like partitioning for B200?

michael: From partner side: H200GA drivers planned in their 2-week window starting 2026-05-05. MI300 firmware rev 3.2 targeted week of 2026-05-12. Gaudi partner wants operator update (k8s device plugin) in same cadence.

lina: Can product commit to perf gates? We usually require <20% tail-latency regression and >=95% accuracy on eval set before marketplace listing.

kevin: That's doable but need clarity: are we testing quantized variants (4-bit/8-bit) for initial launch or only FP16/FP32? Quantization affects kernels and perf profiles.

michael: Partners expect us to validate both FP16 and int8-quantized flows for the marketplace. They also want a join press embargo date.

igor: Ops note: lab has 4x H200 (A100-rack replaced), 2x MI300, 6x Gaudi v2 nodes. Cooling checks scheduled 2026-05-01. Power/cooling might limit sustained throughput tests — call it out in plan. :warning:

sophia: Proposed timeline draft:
- 2026-05-01: kernel/driver matrix published to partners
- 2026-05-05 to 2026-05-12: partner driver/firmware windows
- 2026-05-13 to 2026-05-20: integration + perf runs (FP16 + int8 smoke)
- 2026-05-21: internal perf gating review
- 2026-05-25: freeze for marketplace packaging and announcement draft
- 2026-06-01: joint announcement (embargo lift)
